olivia_support: FYI — Customer (Acme Corp) hit a corp-card decline trying to pay invoice INV-4871 for vendor 'CloudDesk'. Customer says they attached PO# PO-9001. Bank response: "DECLINE: MCC_BLOCKED". Customer needs this cleared today. invoice pdf attached. can we allowlist the merchant or take a manual payment?

andrew_support: Can you paste the decline response payload and last4? Also which billing method did the customer use (card on file vs one-time)?

olivia_support: last4 4242, card on file. decline payload from processor: `{"status":"declined","code":"57","reason":"merchant category not allowed","mcc":5734}`. Customer confirms company policy restricts spend to certain MCCs.

sam_finance: 57 usually means issuer-level MCC restriction. Two paths: 1) customer asks their bank to allow MCC 5734 (software) OR 2) we invoice them via PO (net terms) or process via a different payment method. Did they provide a signed PO?

olivia_support: Yes they uploaded PO-9001 (PDF). They explicitly asked us to run the card — they don't want NET30. They said finance can whitelist the vendor on their card program, but that's on their side.

tara_engineer: From payments infra side, processor won't override issuer MCC rules. We can check if the card is being blocked by our gateway rules (company spend limits or MCC blocking in our billing config). Querying gateway logs now.

billing-bot: [auto] retry scheduled in 2 minutes (attempt 2/3) for invoice INV-4871.

tara_engineer: Gateway logs: our side shows `decline_code=57`, `decline_reason=MCC_NOT_ALLOWED`, no internal MCC blocking rules matched. So this is issuer-side.

sam_finance: Given they have a PO, quick unblock options: - Accept PO and raise manual invoice to AR to process with bank transfer or check - Suggest customer request bank to allow MCC 5734 for that card - Use a different card or corporate virtual card that permits SaaS vendors

nina_cc_ops: If customer prefers card processing now, we can do manual card capture via payments ops but need cardholder auth. For security we can't take raw card numbers via Slack — ask customer to re-add card through billing portal or complete pay-by-link.

andrew_support: Customer replied: "bank says it's a corporate spend policy block, they can allowlist this vendor but it may take 24-48h. We need access to the product immediately."

olivia_support: Customer asked if we can accept the PO now and provision access while payment is pending. Is that allowed?

sam_finance: Policy: for accounts with enterprise contract we can provision on PO receipt + credit hold agreement. This customer is mid-market; we can make an exception if we escalate to Sales for approval. Need Exec sign-off.

andrew_support: Looping in sales for approval. @lena-sales can you review PO-9001 and confirm provisioning ok prior to payment?

olivia_support: Sales (offline): approved temporary access for 48h contingent on receiving signed PO and signed credit addendum.

sam_finance: Finance note: we created AR ticket TKT-7832 to record the PO and manual invoice. Marking invoice INV-4871 as "provision grace" for 48h. Will follow up with collections if no payment after 48h.

olivia_support: Customer accepted. Meanwhile, customer asked if we can request gateway to retry with soft-decline handling (submit transaction with MCC override). Is that possible?

tara_engineer: No — MCC is part of the merchant account configuration and issuer decision. We cannot override MCC in the auth. Only path is different payment instrument or issuer allowlist.

nina_cc_ops: FYI we can send a pay-by-link that will re-tokenize the card; sometimes corporate cards routed via different processor and succeed. Recommend pay-by-link and ask them to try a different card if urgent.

billing-bot: [auto] manual invoice created: AR/TKT-7832 -> INV-4871-MANUAL.

andrew_support: Resolution steps: 1) Sales approved 48h provisioning on receipt of signed PO 2) Finance created manual invoice and AR ticket 3) Customer asked to request bank allowlist for MCC 5734 or try alternate card/pay-link 4) Ops scheduled retries and suggested pay-by-link 5) Mark thread for follow-up in 48h.

olivia_support: Closing loop — I'll follow up in 48h and update here. Posting summary to account notes. :white_check_mark:

andrew_support: Thanks team. Filing internal doc on this case pattern so we can reuse wording for future MCC-blocked declines. :memo:
